note_on_status_conclusion: Registry stores only completed experiments; no status/conclusion fields present. All 123 entries treated as DONE+success.

per_experiment.note: C4 domain; all pairs robust, no non-robust to classify

permg_robust_fwd_status: Field 'PermG_robust_fwd' does NOT exist in registry. The 6/8 vs 8/8 pattern is captured by PermG_fwd (method-level, Permutation Granger forward-only) and robust_pairs_K3 (consensus-level, count of pairs with K>=3 of 5 methods significant).

six_vs_eight_pattern.pattern: 6/8 PermG_fwd always co-occurs with K3=6 (mauve pairs fail, diversity pairs pass). 8/8 PermG_fwd has variable K3 (5-8); in C4 domain mauve pairs often pass too.
six_vs_eight_pattern.interpretation: 6/8 ceiling in wiki-domain = PermG detects 8/8 pairs BUT K3 consensus only achieves 6/8 because mauve pairs fail by TY and Threshold methods. In C4 domain PermG=8/8 AND K3=8/8 in 2 of 4 experiments.

conclusion: Across all 3 experiments with explicit non-robust pair data, 3/3 have ALL non-robust pairs involving mauve as downstream. The non-robust pairs are exclusively token_entropy<mauve and ece<mauve, each scoring 0/5 to 2/5 across the 5-method consensus. The 6 diversity downstream pairs (token_entropy/ece x distinct_1/2/3) consistently pass K>=3 consensus. This is the structural cause of the 6/8 ceiling in wiki-domain experiments. C4-domain experiments can achieve 8/8 K3 (all pairs robust), meaning the mauve failure is domain-specific (wiki) rather than a fundamental metric limitation. PermG_robust_fwd does not exist as a registry field.
